### Problem & Motivation
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are addressing. Example: *"I struggle when trying to..."*

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how the proposed feature would address the problem.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, libraries, or architectural approaches you have considered.

### Expected Benefit & Technical Impact
- How does this benefit the system?
- Does it affect AI inference throughput, recognition decision thresholds, database performance, or UI responsiveness?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or relevant research papers here.
